Totême was founded in 2014 in Stockholm, Sweden by fashion editor Elin Kling and art director Karl Lindman, with the vision of creating a curated wardrobe of timeless essentials. The brand has become renowned worldwide for its Scandinavian minimalism, clean tailoring, and refined uniform dressing, blending understated elegance with everyday functionality.

Totême’s design ethos focuses on wardrobe staples — pieces that transcend seasons and trends. Its collections are built around luxury essentials like tailored coats, silk shirts, knitwear, and premium denim. With flagship stores in Stockholm, New York, London, and Los Angeles, Totême has established itself as a global leader in contemporary luxury fashion, worn by style-conscious individuals who value craftsmanship and timeless design.

When it comes to Totême jeans, the label is celebrated for its sculptural silhouettes, premium fabrics, and minimal detailing. Core pieces such as the Twisted Seam Jeans have achieved cult status, embodying the brand’s signature blend of Scandinavian design clarity and everyday sophistication. Each pair of jeans is designed to be a modern wardrobe foundation, seamlessly pairing with Totême’s coats, knitwear, and accessories for a complete luxury uniform.
